purpose: Compose frozen geometric observation, HS/DNp15 proxies and exploratory orientation into a backend-only model-space motion-feedback experiment. Not biological steering or heading restoration.

analysis.full_spectrum: one simple orientation eigenvalue 1; the three differential eigenvalues; a with multiplicity 5; b once; two zero bookkeeping/latch modes
analysis.feedback_sign: NEGATIVE_MOTION_FEEDBACK: unclipped right=-previous differential, left=+previous differential after perturbation ends
analysis.delay: Previous completed orientation interval supplies current latched motion. Targets read old source states; orientation reads old targets. No algebraic loop.
analysis.clipping_role: Frozen observation-domain bound only; local motion poles already strictly inside unit circle without clipping. Not a stabilizer for an unstable local controller.
analysis.finite_horizon_proof: Convex exponential updates with bounded input and three-channel means keep all HS/target states within [-1,1], hence |yaw_drive|<=2. Over 50ms, neural orientation change is bounded by 2; add at most .001 external perturbation. Each neural interval increment <=.004, initial perturbed increment <=.005, both below .5 observation-domain limit.
analysis.permission_rationale: The sole unit mode is absolute orientation offset, invisible to motion-only sensing. Motion/neural differential modes decay; no unstable mode or output-driven stabilization exists. A finite-horizon motion perturbation probe is interpretable.

duration_rationale: Five frozen target time constants and ten source time constants, within the existing 50ms orientation validation horizon. Selected before closed-loop outputs; no extension or shortening to obtain stabilization.

perturbation.rationale: Half of one descriptor-reference displacement for frozen dt: 0.5*(0.1ms/50ms)*period_eq. Bounded geometric input convention, not selected from neural response or desired orientation.

independent_state_dimension: 12 coordinates with latch/previous-orientation consistency constraints; observation fields and per-route contributions are derived readouts, not hidden dynamic state

equations.observation: At n>=1 observe known theta[n-1] -> theta[n] over its actual endpoint duration through the frozen Phase29 API; at n=0 use declared neutral descriptors.
equations.routing: contributions,drive = Phase25 route_contributions(s[n], verified six routes, targets, frozen scale); count fields are provenance only
equations.embodiment: Apply the frozen Phase28 integrate_orientation kernel on local [0,actual_interval_dt] with old target pair held to obtain its neutral-origin increment, then accumulate that increment in authoritative orientation. No body state reset.
equations.open_loop: Disconnect only the returned neural orientation increment; still compute observation, sources, targets and proposed Phase28 increment. No condition-specific gain.
equations.final_boundary: Observe last completed interval and store readouts; no source/target/orientation update and no extra perturbation. Final observation is not consumed.

time_semantics: Neural dt remains exactly the frozen 0.1ms parameter. Phase28/29 use actual differences of n*dt endpoint timestamps, as their frozen APIs specify; tiny floating-point endpoint differences do not change model parameters.
motion_only_limitation: No absolute heading-error observation. Static offsets are equilibria; returning to world heading zero is not a success criterion.
observation_clipping: Use frozen Phase29 symmetric clipping and report actual clipping flags, including floating-point boundary behavior; no additional saturation or tolerance.

runtime_validity.policy: Stop deterministically at the offending boundary; record error and last valid trajectory, never clamp invalid state or fabricate remaining samples. Authority mismatch prevents execution entirely.

diagnostics.crossing_definition: Count sign transitions between successive nonzero samples, skipping exact zeros; zero-crossing bracket count uses the same convention. No fitted interpolation or arbitrary tolerance.
diagnostics.clipping_denominator: All completed observed intervals, excluding initial boundary; final observation is included but not consumed. Clipping duration sums actual observed interval durations.

outputs: Per boundary: time/world, orientation and previous orientation, full Phase29 observation or null at initial boundary, latched R/L, six source states, two targets, six route contributions, target drives, differential/yaw drive, proposed/applied neural increment and external increment where an outgoing interval exists, clipping flag, termination and diagnostics.
acceptance: Accept neutral, decaying, oscillatory, offset, weak, unexpected finite or saturated outcomes without retuning. StageA unstable or ambiguous composition forbids first execution.
allowed_claims: Marginal absolute orientation and decaying local motion modes
forbidden_claims: Actual fly navigation or heading control
